ex.en: I met her on campus yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天在校園裡遇到她。

ex.en: She showed me around the campus.
ex.zh: 她帶我參觀了校園。

ex.en: We met in a coffee shop near the campus.
ex.zh: 我們在學校附近的咖啡店碰面。

ex.en: This instrument needs to be calibrated.
ex.zh: 這台儀器需要校準。

ex.en: Calibrate the scale before you weigh the samples.
ex.zh: 秤樣本之前先校準磅秤。

ex.en: Taking the train instead of flying reduces your carbon footprint.
ex.zh: 搭火車而不搭飛機可以減少碳足跡。

ex.en: The company wants to cut its carbon footprint in half.
ex.zh: 這家公司想把碳足跡減半。

ex.en: The telephone operator asked the caller to hold on until a connection was made.
ex.zh: 接線生請來電者稍候，等待接通。

ex.en: The caller didn't leave a message.
ex.zh: 來電的人沒有留言。

ex.en: We received dozens of callers asking about the sale.
ex.zh: 我們接到好幾十通來電詢問特賣活動。

ex.en: You have a caller waiting at the front desk.
ex.zh: 有一位訪客在櫃檯等你。

ex.en: We don't get many callers on Sundays.
ex.zh: 星期天我們這裡不太有訪客。

cafeteria.zh: 自助餐廳；（公司、學校的）員工餐廳

ex.en: The food in the cafeteria is cheap, and it's delicious.
ex.zh: 餐廳的餐點很便宜，而且很好吃。

ex.en: He eats lunch at a cafeteria.
ex.zh: 他在自助餐廳吃午餐。

ex.en: I'd like to work at the cafeteria.
ex.zh: 我想在餐廳工作。

ex.en: I had a cup of coffee at the cafe.
ex.zh: 我在咖啡館喝了一杯咖啡。

ex.en: I drink coffee in a cafe.
ex.zh: 我在咖啡館喝咖啡。

ex.en: Is there a cafe?
ex.zh: 這裡有咖啡館嗎？

ex.en: She hung the calendar on the wall.
ex.zh: 她把月曆掛在牆上。

ex.en: In the Spanish calendar, the week begins with Monday.
ex.zh: 在西班牙的日曆上，一週從星期一開始。

ex.en: In China, they celebrate New Year by the lunar calendar.
ex.zh: 在中國，人們依農曆過新年。

ex.en: Let me check my calendar before I say yes.
ex.zh: 答應之前讓我先看一下我的行事曆。

ex.en: I'll send you a calendar invite for Friday's meeting.
ex.zh: 我會寄給你星期五會議的行事曆邀請。

ex.en: Please replace the empty ink cartridge in the printer.
ex.zh: 請把印表機裡沒墨水的墨水匣換掉。

ex.en: We need to order more toner cartridges.
ex.zh: 我們需要再訂一些碳粉匣。

ex.en: This printer cartridge costs almost as much as the printer.
ex.zh: 這個印表機墨水匣幾乎跟印表機一樣貴。

ex.en: Jessie strolled along beside the cart.
ex.zh: 傑西在推車旁邊慢慢走著。

ex.en: I put the milk in the shopping cart.
ex.zh: 我把牛奶放進購物車。

ex.en: Click here to add the item to your cart.
ex.zh: 點這裡把商品加入購物車。

ex.en: A horse pulled the cart along the road.
ex.zh: 一匹馬沿著路拉著貨車。

ex.en: I saw a horse pulling a cart.
ex.zh: 我看到一匹馬在拉車。

ex.en: The captain is responsible for the safety of passengers.
ex.zh: 船長要負責乘客的安全。

ex.en: Captains have responsibility for ship and crew.
ex.zh: 船長要對船隻和船員負責。

ex.en: This is your captain speaking. We will land shortly.
ex.zh: 這裡是機長廣播，我們即將降落。

ex.en: Tom is the captain of this baseball team.
ex.zh: 湯姆是這支棒球隊的隊長。

ex.en: We want you to be the team captain.
ex.zh: 我們希望你當隊長。

ex.en: George is the captain of our team.
ex.zh: 喬治是我們隊的隊長。

ex.en: The calculator on the table is mine.
ex.zh: 桌上那台計算機是我的。

ex.en: The batteries in my calculator are dead.
ex.zh: 我計算機的電池沒電了。

ex.en: You may use a calculator during the exam.
ex.zh: 考試時可以使用計算機。

ex.en: I took a cab to the station.
ex.zh: 我搭了計程車到車站。

ex.en: I left my umbrella in the cab.
ex.zh: 我把我的傘忘在計程車上了。

ex.en: He called a cab for me.
ex.zh: 他幫我叫了一輛計程車。

ex.en: The writer is living in a log cabin.
ex.zh: 那位作家住在一間小木屋裡。

ex.en: He built a cabin on the beach.
ex.zh: 他在海灘上蓋了一間小屋。

ex.en: The cabin crew will serve drinks shortly.
ex.zh: 空服員稍後將提供飲料。

ex.en: Our cabin on the ship had a small window.
ex.zh: 我們在船上的艙房有一扇小窗。

ex.en: We can wear casual clothes on Fridays.
ex.zh: 我們星期五可以穿便服。

ex.en: The restaurant has a casual atmosphere.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳氣氛很輕鬆。

ex.en: He made a casual remark about the budget.
ex.zh: 他隨口提到了預算的事。

ex.en: It was just a casual conversation.
ex.zh: 那只是隨意聊聊而已。

ex.en: The factory hires casual workers in summer.
ex.zh: 工廠夏天會僱用臨時工。

ex.en: She has a casual job at a café.
ex.zh: 她在咖啡店打零工。

ex.en: There is a fee for late cancellations.
ex.zh: 太晚取消要收手續費。

ex.en: We had a cancellation, so a room is now available.
ex.zh: 有人取消訂房，所以現在有空房了。

ex.en: The carpenter brought his tools along.
ex.zh: 木匠把工具帶來了。

ex.en: My grandfather is a carpenter.
ex.zh: 我爺爺是個木匠。

ex.en: He is a good carpenter.
ex.zh: 他是個好木匠。

ex.en: We hired a caterer for the company party.
ex.zh: 我們請了外燴業者負責公司派對。

ex.en: The caterer will arrive two hours before the event.
ex.zh: 外燴業者會在活動前兩小時抵達。

ex.en: The calculation of the budget for next year is based on the costs this year.
ex.zh: 明年的預算是根據今年的成本計算的。

ex.en: According to my calculation, she should be in India by now.
ex.zh: 依我的推算，她現在應該已經到印度了。

ex.en: There was an error in the calculation.
ex.zh: 計算過程中有一個錯誤。

ex.en: Please use caution when driving in the rain.
ex.zh: 雨天開車請小心。

ex.en: Handle this box with caution.
ex.zh: 搬這個箱子要小心。

ex.en: Caution! Wet floor.
ex.zh: 小心地滑！

ex.en: Caution! Wet Paint
ex.zh: 注意！油漆未乾。

ex.en: The doctor cautioned me against eating too much salt.
ex.zh: 醫生告誡我不要吃太鹹。

ex.en: Experts caution that prices may rise again.
ex.zh: 專家警告物價可能再次上漲。

ex.en: My son took a candy from the box.
ex.zh: 我兒子從盒子裡拿了一顆糖。

ex.en: Divide the candies among you.
ex.zh: 你們把這些糖果分一分吧。

ex.en: I never should've let Tom eat so much candy.
ex.zh: 我真不該讓湯姆吃那麼多糖果。

ex.en: I bought a carton of milk.
ex.zh: 我買了一盒牛奶。

ex.en: The products are packed in cartons of 12.
ex.zh: 產品以每箱十二個包裝。

ex.en: Please recycle the empty cartons.
ex.zh: 請回收空紙箱。

ex.en: It was careless of you to leave the door unlocked.
ex.zh: 你沒鎖門，真是太不小心了。

ex.en: It is careless of her to make such a mistake.
ex.zh: 她會犯這種錯，真是太粗心了。

ex.en: A careless person is apt to make mistakes.
ex.zh: 粗心的人容易犯錯。

ex.en: She's very cautious.
ex.zh: 她很謹慎。

ex.en: You must be cautious.
ex.zh: 你一定要小心。

ex.en: Investors are cautious about the market.
ex.zh: 投資人對市場態度謹慎。

ex.en: The girl released the birds from the cage.
ex.zh: 女孩把鳥從籠子裡放了出來。

ex.en: The tiger laid in the middle of the cage.
ex.zh: 老虎躺在籠子中間。

ex.en: She set the bird free from the cage.
ex.zh: 她把小鳥從籠子裡放走了。

ex.en: Capitalism encourages competition among businesses.
ex.zh: 資本主義鼓勵企業之間互相競爭。

ex.en: The professor gave a lecture on the history of capitalism.
ex.zh: 教授講了一堂關於資本主義歷史的課。

ex.en: The company's market capitalization exceeds ten billion dollars.
ex.zh: 這家公司的市值超過一百億美元。

ex.en: Market capitalization is the share price times the number of shares.
ex.zh: 市值就是股價乘以股數。

ex.en: Check the spelling and capitalization before you submit.
ex.zh: 交出去之前檢查一下拼字和大小寫。

ex.en: Capitalization rules are different in German.
ex.zh: 德文的大寫規則不一樣。

capitalist.zh: 資本家；投資者（venture capitalist 創投業者）

ex.en: The startup is looking for a venture capitalist.
ex.zh: 那家新創公司正在找創投業者。

ex.en: Early capitalists built factories across the country.
ex.zh: 早期的資本家在全國各地建了工廠。

ex.en: Russia wasn't capitalist.
ex.zh: 俄羅斯當時並不是資本主義國家。

ex.en: The country has a capitalist economy.
ex.zh: 這個國家實行資本主義經濟。

ex.en: I didn't mean to capitalize this.
ex.zh: 我不是故意要用大寫的。

ex.en: Do not forget to capitalize.
ex.zh: 別忘了用大寫。

capitalize.zh: capitalize on：利用（機會）、趁勢獲利

ex.en: We should capitalize on this opportunity.
ex.zh: 我們應該好好利用這個機會。

ex.en: The company capitalized on the growing demand for electric cars.
ex.zh: 這家公司抓住了電動車需求成長的商機。

ex.en: Toyota is one of the world's largest carmakers.
ex.zh: 豐田是全球最大的汽車製造商之一。

ex.en: The carmaker recalled thousands of vehicles.
ex.zh: 這家車廠召回了數千輛汽車。

ex.en: The oil cartel agreed to cut production.
ex.zh: 石油卡特爾同意減產。

ex.en: The companies were fined for forming a price cartel.
ex.zh: 這些公司因聯合壟斷價格而被罰款。

ex.en: There were no casualties in the fire.
ex.zh: 這場火災沒有人傷亡。

ex.en: The accident caused several casualties.
ex.zh: 這起事故造成數人傷亡。

ex.en: Small businesses were the first casualties of the recession.
ex.zh: 小型企業是經濟衰退最先受害的對象。

ex.en: Quality became a casualty of the rush to finish.
ex.zh: 為了趕工，品質成了犧牲品。

ex.en: The hotel has a casino on the first floor.
ex.zh: 這家飯店一樓有賭場。

ex.en: He lost a lot of money at the casino.
ex.zh: 他在賭場輸了很多錢。

ex.en: Their cattle are all fat.
ex.zh: 他們的牛都很肥。

ex.en: Look after the cattle.
ex.zh: 把那些牛照顧好。

ex.en: The oil spill was an environmental catastrophe.
ex.zh: 那次漏油事件是一場環境浩劫。

ex.en: Losing the files would be a catastrophe for the project.
ex.zh: 遺失那些檔案對專案來說會是一場災難。

ex.en: You could count to ten when you were two.
ex.zh: 你兩歲時就能數到十了。

ex.en: Can you speak Japanese?
ex.zh: 你會說日文嗎？

ex.en: Can I use your phone?
ex.zh: 我可以用你的手機嗎？

ex.en: You can leave early today.
ex.zh: 你今天可以早點下班。

ex.en: It can't be true!
ex.zh: 那不可能是真的！

ex.en: Mornings can be very cold here.
ex.zh: 這裡早上有時會很冷。

ex.en: I bought a can of soda.
ex.zh: 我買了一罐汽水。

ex.en: Please recycle your empty cans.
ex.zh: 請回收空罐。

ex.en: Cottage cheese and canned peaches are a delicious combination.
ex.zh: 茅屋起司配桃子罐頭是很美味的組合。

ex.en: Tom got mercury poisoning from eating canned tuna every day.
ex.zh: 湯姆每天吃鮪魚罐頭，結果汞中毒了。

ex.en: This rule does not apply in all cases.
ex.zh: 這條規則並非適用於所有情況。

ex.en: We can find similar situations in these next few cases.
ex.zh: 在接下來這幾個例子中，我們也能看到類似的情況。

ex.en: In that case, let's meet tomorrow.
ex.zh: 那樣的話，我們明天見吧。

ex.en: He intended to reexamine the case from the beginning.
ex.zh: 他打算從頭重新調查這個案件。

ex.en: It is difficult for me to handle the case.
ex.zh: 這個案子我很難處理。

ex.en: In case of fire, do not use the lift.
ex.zh: 發生火災時，請勿搭乘電梯。

ex.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
ex.zh: 帶把傘以防下雨。

ex.en: I need a new phone case.
ex.zh: 我需要一個新的手機殼。

ex.en: She put her glasses back in the case.
ex.zh: 她把眼鏡放回眼鏡盒。

ex.en: It's time for you to buy a new car.
ex.zh: 你該買一輛新車了。

ex.en: This road is too narrow for cars to pass.
ex.zh: 這條路太窄，車子過不去。

ex.en: My physics teacher doesn't care if I skip classes.
ex.zh: 我的物理老師不在乎我是否翹課。

ex.en: I think you're the only one who cares.
ex.zh: 我覺得你是唯一在乎的人。

ex.en: I don't care as long as you are happy.
ex.zh: 只要你開心，我都無所謂。

ex.en: He cared for his mother after his father died.
ex.zh: 父親過世後，他就照顧母親。

ex.en: No one is caring for this patient.
ex.zh: 沒有人在照顧這位病人。

ex.en: Handle this package with care.
ex.zh: 這個包裹請小心輕放。

ex.en: Patients here receive excellent care.
ex.zh: 這裡的病人受到很好的照顧。

ex.en: The committee inquired into the cause of the accident.
ex.zh: 委員會調查了事故的原因。

ex.en: Research on the causes of cancer is very expensive.
ex.zh: 癌症成因的研究非常昂貴。

ex.en: The explosion may have been caused by a gas leak.
ex.zh: 這起爆炸可能是瓦斯外洩引起的。

ex.en: The Taiwanese dollar appreciated, causing Taiwanese exports to slump.
ex.zh: 新台幣升值，造成台灣出口大幅下滑。

ex.en: Sorry for causing so much trouble.
ex.zh: 抱歉造成這麼多麻煩。

ex.en: Tom always carries a camera with him wherever he goes.
ex.zh: 湯姆不管去哪裡都帶著相機。

ex.en: The young woman was carrying an infant in her arms.
ex.zh: 那位年輕女子懷裡抱著嬰兒。

ex.en: This machine is too heavy for me to carry.
ex.zh: 這台機器太重了，我搬不動。

ex.en: This plan will be very expensive to carry out.
ex.zh: 這個計畫執行起來會非常昂貴。

ex.en: We will carry out a customer survey next month.
ex.zh: 我們下個月將進行顧客調查。

ex.en: We carried on the discussion till late at night.
ex.zh: 我們一直討論到深夜。

ex.en: Please carry on with your work.
ex.zh: 請繼續你的工作。

ex.en: Do you carry this shirt in a larger size?
ex.zh: 這件襯衫有賣大一點的尺寸嗎？

ex.en: The store carries many local brands.
ex.zh: 這家店有賣很多本土品牌。

ex.en: You will not be able to catch the train.
ex.zh: 你會趕不上火車。

ex.en: I have to catch the eight o'clock bus.
ex.zh: 我得趕上八點的公車。

ex.en: We all caught flu, and so did the teacher.
ex.zh: 我們全都得了流感，連老師也是。

ex.en: I caught a cold and was in bed yesterday.
ex.zh: 我感冒了，昨天躺在床上休息。

ex.en: Tom caught the ball with one hand.
ex.zh: 湯姆單手接住了球。

ex.en: The police caught the thief last night.
ex.zh: 警察昨晚抓到了小偷。

ex.en: Sorry, I didn't catch your name.
ex.zh: 抱歉，我沒聽清楚你的名字。

ex.en: I didn't catch what he said.
ex.zh: 我沒聽清楚他說什麼。

ex.en: If you hurry, you will catch up with him.
ex.zh: 如果你快一點，還能追上他。

ex.en: We have lots of catching up to do.
ex.zh: 我們有好多近況要聊。

ex.en: How many Christmas cards did you write last year?
ex.zh: 你去年寫了幾張聖誕卡？

ex.en: At Christmas we send Christmas cards to our friends.
ex.zh: 聖誕節時我們寄聖誕卡給朋友。

ex.en: I would like to pay with a credit card.
ex.zh: 我想用信用卡付款。

ex.en: My ID card has expired, what should I do?
ex.zh: 我的身分證過期了，該怎麼辦？

ex.en: I usually use a credit card instead of cash.
ex.zh: 我通常用信用卡，而不是現金。

ex.en: Place the deck of cards on the oaken table.
ex.zh: 把那副撲克牌放在橡木桌上。

ex.en: Let's play cards after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚餐後來玩牌吧。

ex.en: Tom and Mary went camping in the mountains.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗去山上露營。

ex.en: Tom doesn't have any friends who like camping.
ex.zh: 湯姆沒有喜歡露營的朋友。

ex.en: We camped by the lake last weekend.
ex.zh: 我們上週末在湖邊露營。

ex.en: The blizzard made it difficult for us to return to the camp.
ex.zh: 暴風雪讓我們很難回到營地。

ex.en: A small rock was thrown into our camp.
ex.zh: 有顆小石頭被丟進我們的營地。

ex.en: My son is going to summer camp in July.
ex.zh: 我兒子七月要去參加夏令營。

ex.en: He divided his books into five categories.
ex.zh: 他把他的書分成五類。

ex.en: You need to create two new categories.
ex.zh: 你需要建立兩個新分類。

ex.en: Which category does this product belong to?
ex.zh: 這項產品屬於哪個類別？

ex.en: Research on the causes of cancer is very expensive.
ex.zh: 研究癌症成因的費用非常高。

ex.en: Scientists haven't found a cure for cancer yet.
ex.zh: 科學家還沒找到治療癌症的方法。

ex.en: Tiny particles in the air can cause cancer.
ex.zh: 空氣中的微粒可能會致癌。

ex.en: The old man walked across the road carefully.
ex.zh: 老人小心翼翼地過馬路。

ex.en: Compare the two carefully, and you will see the difference.
ex.zh: 仔細比較這兩者，你就會看出差別。

ex.en: When taking drugs, follow the directions on the bottle carefully.
ex.zh: 服藥時要仔細遵照瓶身上的說明。

ex.en: I'm going to buy a camera for my daughter.
ex.zh: 我打算買一台相機給我女兒。

ex.en: Japan produces a lot of good cameras.
ex.zh: 日本生產很多好相機。

ex.en: Your camera is only half the size of mine.
ex.zh: 你的相機只有我的一半大。

ex.en: Security cameras are installed in the lobby.
ex.zh: 大廳裝有監視攝影機。

ex.en: Please turn on your camera during the video call.
ex.zh: 視訊通話時請打開你的鏡頭。

ex.en: The movie has an amazing cast.
ex.zh: 這部電影的演員陣容很強大。

ex.en: The cast of the play includes several famous actors.
ex.zh: 這齣戲的演員包括幾位知名演員。

ex.en: She cast a shy glance on the young man.
ex.zh: 她害羞地看了那個年輕人一眼。

ex.en: Millions of people cast their votes yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天有數百萬人投下了選票。

ex.en: His arm is in a cast after the accident.
ex.zh: 意外後他的手臂打了石膏。

ex.en: She had to wear a cast for six weeks.
ex.zh: 她得打六週的石膏。

ex.en: You cannot be too careful in crossing a street.
ex.zh: 過馬路再怎麼小心都不為過。

ex.en: You must be more careful about spelling and punctuation.
ex.zh: 你在拼字和標點符號上要更仔細。

ex.en: You must be careful not to make him angry.
ex.zh: 你要小心別惹他生氣。

ex.en: The policeman captured the man who was running.

ex.zh: 男孩伸手又拿了一塊蛋糕。

ex.zh: 這塊蛋糕吃起來好像有加起司。

ex.zh: 把筆蓋蓋回去。

ex.zh: 這個國家每人的醫療支出比鄰國高。

ex.zh: 她在肩上披了一件保暖的斗篷。

ex.zh: 我和她晚上八點半在大教堂碰面。

ex.zh: 那座大教堂是這座城市最有名的地標。
